method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (salsl-core.l4) with five regulative rules (payment in lieu immediately on termination, s 8(4)(b); the Form 2 statement before leave, s 10(6); compliance with an inspector's notice, s 12(1); the SAET application within three years, s 13(4); no other employment in place of the employment while on leave, s 14(1), SHANT) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the worker) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, numbers or dates, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 1987 (SA), No 73 of 1987, the register's current version 1.7.2017, as the unauthorised RTF fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 and deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/long-service-leave-act-1987.txt; with the Long Service Leave Regulations 2017, version 1.9.2017, deposited at subjects/au/sa/long-service-leave-regulations-2017/registers/source-bundle/ (reg 4 and Forms 2 and 3 named). Not the authorised PDFs.

seat: the worker: the person employed under a contract of service who has earned or is earning long service leave; for the questions a death raises (s 5(5), s 8(4)(b), s 13(2)(b)), the worker's personal representative (salsl-seat.l4)
focus: one of the State long service leave Acts the claims list names generically (employment): the whole operative Act

checks.result: 171 assertions written, 171 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control on a scratch copy (the s 6(1)(i) window two months to three, the s 7(3) notice 60 days to 59) failed exactly the 8 predicted assertions
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The whole operative Act. In: s 3(1)-(4); s 4; s 5(1)-(7); s 6(1)-(4); s 7(3), (4)(c), (d), (6), (7); s 8(1)-(4); s 9(3), (5); s 10(2)(c), (5), (6), (7) and the penalties of s 10(1), (2a), (4); s 11(3) (penalty); s 12(1)-(4), (6), (7); s 13(1)-(4); s 14(1), (2); s 15; s 16; Regulations reg 4 and Forms 2 and 3 (named). Out: ss 1, 17 (machinery); s 7(1), (2), (4)(a), (b) (hortatory or permissive; finding 1); s 9(1), (2), (4), (6) (SAET's exemption power); s 10(1) contents, (2)(a), (b), (3), (4) duties; s 11(1), (2), (4) (inspector's powers); Schedule cl 2 and the 2016 Act's s 118 (transitional). Reasons in NOTES.md.
